subject: Notice: Temporary Telemetry Processor Addition & Evidence Timeline
messages:
From: Alex Jordan <ajordan@greenbank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenBank Procurement <procurements@greenbank.com>, Velaris Systems <security@velaris.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Add Velaris as temporary telemetry processor for pilot

Hi Rafael —

We’re launching a 6-week pilot with Velaris Systems to collect enriched telemetry for our payments flows and we need to confirm whether Redwood can onboard them as a temporary telemetry processor for GreenBank traffic. Procurement asked for the following so we can sign the forward-facing paperwork:

- Subprocessor roster and intended scope (what data they will see)
- Data flow diagram for telemetry and any egress paths
- Evidence of security controls (SOC2 Type II, transit+rest encryption)
- Estimated onboarding/cutover timeline (we are targeting Jul 20 start)

Can you confirm next steps and who on your side will own the evidence package? I’ve attached our intake form to help.

Thanks,
Alex Jordan
Procurement Manager — GreenBank
procurements@greenbank.com
Attachment: greenbank_proc_req_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <ajordan@greenbank.com>
Cc: GreenBank Procurement <procurements@greenbank.com>, Velaris Systems <security@velaris.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Add Velaris as temporary telemetry processor for pilot

Alex —

Thanks for the note and the intake form. Redwood can support onboarding Velaris as a temporary telemetry processor under a limited-scope addendum. To proceed we will need the evidence listed below. Marissa will assemble the packet once we receive items from Velaris; Kimberly will confirm legal/DPA steps.

Required from Velaris (minimum):
- Current SOC2 Type II (redacted if necessary)
- Network diagram + dataflow showing what telemetry fields are collected and any PII/identifiers
- Transit encryption and key management description (do they use KMS/HSM?)
- Country of processing and any subcontractors they will use
- Retention policy for forwarded telemetry

Proposed timeline (internal):
- 07/07: Evidence request sent (this email)
- 07/09: Evidence received (target)
- 07/11: Internal review + legal sign-off
- 07/20: Pilot cutover (GreenBank traffic routed to Velaris)

I’m copying Marissa (onboarding) and Kimberly (privacy/legal). Marissa — once we have the files please attach them to the intake workspace and flag any gaps.

Attachment: redwood_evidence_request_checklist.pdf

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Security — Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — redwood.com

From: Alex Jordan <ajordan@greenbank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenBank Procurement <procurements@greenbank.com>, Velaris Systems <security@velaris.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 08:21:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Add Velaris as temporary telemetry processor for pilot

Rafael —

Thanks for the quick reply. Velaris confirmed they can produce SOC2 (redacted) and a network diagram but asked for an abbreviated review window — they can turn everything around by COB 07/10 if that helps. A couple of clarifying questions from our security team:

1) Will telemetry forwarded to Velaris contain any tokens or payment identifiers, or do you plan to scrub those before egress?
2) If Velaris processes EU-origin traffic, will Redwood ensure that EU data is routed to an onshore/approved node or will it flow to Velaris’ US tenancy?
3) Is DocuSign DPA addendum acceptance required from us now, or can we get preliminary approval subject to final DPA addendum signature?

I’ve attached GreenBank security questions.xlsx with the team’s checklist. We’re aiming to avoid any blocking delays — the Velaris timeline is tight.

Best,
Alex
Attachment: greenbank_security_questions.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jordan <ajordan@greenbank.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Velaris Systems <security@velaris.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Add Velaris as temporary telemetry processor for pilot

Alex / Rafael —

Appreciate the quick coordination. A few quick responses inline (quoted):

> 1) Will telemetry forwarded to Velaris contain any tokens or payment identifiers, or do you plan to scrub those before egress?

We will not route raw payment tokens. Redwood will apply a minimal normalization/scrubbing step at the routing layer: no PAN, no full account numbers, and no 3DS auth tokens will be forwarded. If GreenBank requires additional field-level filtering, Marissa’s team can add a suppression map pre-cutover.

> 2) If Velaris processes EU-origin traffic, will Redwood ensure that EU data is routed to an onshore/approved node or will it flow to Velaris’ US tenancy?

For this pilot, EU-origin traffic must remain in EU. Velaris’ EU tenancy is available but we need proof of regional tenancy and contractual residency commitments in the DPA addendum. If Velaris cannot provide that, we will filter EU traffic out of the pilot.

> 3) Is DocuSign DPA addendum acceptance required from us now, or can we get preliminary approval subject to final DPA addendum signature?

Prelim approval is possible, but no routing until the signed addendum is in place. We can provide a DocuSign link for the addendum once Velaris returns the evidence package.

Velaris / GreenBank: please upload the requested artifacts to the shared drive link below and include any attestation for KMS/HSM usage. I’ve attached a short KMS attestation template to make this faster.

Drive link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_example_docid
Attachment: kms_attestation_request_template.docx

—Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Evidence packet: Velaris onboarding (redacted) + next steps

Alex / team —

Attached is the redacted evidence packet Velaris provided and our internal review notes. Summary:

- SOC2 Type II (redacted) — found to be current; no outstanding exceptions
- Network diagram + dataflow (velaris_network_diagram.pdf) — telemetry fields enumerated; no payment PANs or 3DS tokens transmitted
- KMS attestation (velaris_kms_attestation_signed.docx) — Velaris uses AWS KMS with HSM-backed keys
- Country of processing: US primary, EU tenancy available on request (Velaris confirmed EU tenancy exists but requires activation)
- Retention: default 30 days for enriched telemetry; configurable per-customer

Action items / notes:
- GreenBank: to get preliminary approval we need DocuSign DPA addendum signed. I’ve included the DocuSign draft link below. We can proceed to a conditional internal approval now but routing will not occur until signature.
- If GreenBank requires EU-residency for pilot, we need confirmation from Velaris to activate EU tenancy (Velaris told us they can activate by 07/18)

Attachments included: marissa_evidence_packet_redacted.zip (contains SOC2 redacted PDF, network_diagram, kms attestation)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/to/dpa-addendum-example
